column1: # Copied from otfabric/iec60870-5-interop tests/iec101/known-bugs.tsv at v0.5.0 (contract 2.3).
# Known bugs of upstream versions for IEC 60870-5-101, for scripts/interop.sh.
# Same columns and rules as tests/iec104/known-bugs.tsv. A bug is listed
# only with evidence from a run (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md). Two additions for
# the serial standards: column 1 may be "<adapter>@server" or
# "<adapter>@client" (the entry applies to that role only), and the regex is
# matched against the operation followed by " --link-mode <mode of the run>";
# an entry whose regex names a link mode is active only in a run of that mode.

column4: A balanced digitalpetri station never initializes its own primary direction: it sends user data (function 3, FCV 1) to the controlling station without request status of link (9) and reset of remote link (0) first, which IEC 60870-5-101:2003 clause 6 (figures 8 and 9) requires; a controlling station whose secondary keeps the "not reset" state (cB-Sigma) ignores the data, so no answer arrives
